title: DataProductEnvelope
description: The `(kind, schemaVersion, payload)` primitive every per-render data product is wrapped in on the wire and on disk. Prose spec: docs/daemon/DATA-PRODUCTS.md (§ The primitive). A producer picks exactly one transport per kind: inline `payload`, a sibling-file `path`, or base64 `bytes`.

x-composeai.note: The payload shape is per-kind; see the kind's own schema. This envelope only constrains the wrapper.

schemaVersion.description: Positive integer owned by the kind. Bumped only on incompatible payload changes; additive fields do not bump.

payload.description: Inline JSON; shape per-kind. Use for anything under ~64 KB serialised.

path.description: Absolute path to a sibling file the renderer wrote; lifecycle matches the PNG.

bytes.description: base64; only when the caller passed `inline: true`.
